cases.green: Create a hypothetical interactive quiz or example script without real student data and test it before reuse. Write a minimal reproducible example stripped of all real identifiers and data.
cases.yellow: Any LMS integration, tool deployment or capture of student interactions needs academic, technical, accessibility and privacy review. Verify repository visibility, licences and data classes before using context-aware coding tools.
cases.red: Do not publish insecure AI-generated LMS code, expose course credentials or collect student messages through an unassessed agent. Do not turn on repository indexing for uncertain source material.
cases.tool_advice: No tool recommended for the actual material at this information level. You can still use Microsoft Copilot with York sign-in and Enterprise Data Protection with synthetic examples that contain none of the source records.
